problem.title: 找出所有重复的编号
problem.description:
仓库给 n 件货物贴编号，编号只会是 0 到 n-1 之间的整数。录入时出了差错，有的编号被贴在了不止一件货物上（至少有一个这样的编号）。请找出所有被重复使用的编号。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 03。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，依次是每件货物的编号，每个编号都在 0 到 n-1 之间。保证至少有一个编号出现了两次或更多。
problem.output: 一行，按从小到大的顺序输出所有出现次数不少于 2 的编号，以空格分隔，每个编号只输出一次。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中，编号 1 出现了 2 次，编号 4 出现了 3 次，其余编号各出现一次，所以输出 1 4。
样例 2 只有两件货物，编号都是 1。
hints: 编号范围恰好是 0 到 n-1，一个长度为 n 的计数数组就能代替哈希表。
想做到额外空间 O(1)：把每个数交换到和它相等的下标上，交换时发现目标位置已经放着同样的数，它就是重复的。

en.title: Find Every Reused Label
en.description:
A warehouse labels n parcels with integers from 0 to n-1. A data-entry slip put some labels on more than one parcel (at least one label is reused). Find every label that was used more than once.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 03. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, the label of each parcel, each between 0 and n-1. At least one label appears two or more times.
en.output: One line: every label that appears at least twice, in increasing order, separated by spaces, each label printed once.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, label 1 appears twice and label 4 three times; every other label appears once, so the answer is 1 4.
Sample 2 has two parcels, both labelled 1.
hints: Labels lie exactly in 0..n-1, so a counting array of length n can replace a hash table.
For O(1) extra space, swap each value to the index equal to it; if that slot already holds the same value, the value is a repeat.

problem.title: 把空格编码成 %20
problem.description:
在网址里，空格不能直接出现，要写成 %20。给你一行文字，请把其中的每一个空格都替换成 %20，其余字符保持不变。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 05。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行字符串，长度在 1 到 10000 之间，由大小写字母、数字、标点和空格组成。开头、结尾都可能有空格，也可能有连续的空格。
problem.output: 一行，替换后的字符串。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中有两个空格，各自变成 %20。
样例 2 的开头有一个空格、中间有两个相邻的空格，每个空格都要单独替换，所以出现了 %20%20。
hints: 先数出空格个数，就能算出结果的长度；从后往前填写，每个字符只需移动一次。
不要先去掉首尾空格，也不要把连续空格合并成一个。

en.title: Encode Spaces as %20
en.description:
A URL cannot hold a raw space; it is written as %20. Given one line of text, replace every space with %20 and leave every other character as it is.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 05. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line of length 1 to 10000 made of letters, digits, punctuation and spaces. It may start or end with spaces and may contain runs of spaces.
en.output: One line: the text after the replacement.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 has two spaces, each becoming %20.
Sample 2 starts with a space and has two spaces in a row; each one is replaced separately, which gives %20%20.
hints: Count the spaces first to know the final length, then fill the result from the back so each character moves once.
Do not trim the ends and do not merge runs of spaces.

problem.title: 倒着读出一条链表
problem.description:
内存里有一条单向链表，共 n 个结点，结点编号为 0 到 n-1。每个结点存了一个整数值和下一个结点的编号，最后一个结点的“下一个”是 -1。结点的描述是乱序给出的，你只知道头结点的编号。
请从尾结点开始，一直到头结点，依次输出每个结点的值。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 06。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 h（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，0 ≤ h < n），表示结点数和头结点的编号。
接下来 n 行，第 i 行（i 从 0 开始）两个整数 v 和 nx，表示 i 号结点的值为 v（-10^9 ≤ v ≤ 10^9），下一个结点的编号为 nx（nx 为 -1 表示没有下一个结点）。
保证从头结点出发沿着 nx 走，恰好经过所有 n 个结点各一次。
problem.output: 一行 n 个整数，从尾结点到头结点依次输出结点的值，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 的链表是 2 号 → 0 号 → 3 号 → 1 号，值依次为 7、5、-2、9，倒过来就是 9 -2 5 7。
样例 2 只有一个结点。
hints: 沿着 nx 走一遍记下顺序，再倒序输出；也可以用栈，或者用递归在“回来”的时候输出。
链表很长时，递归可能栈溢出，迭代写法更稳妥。

en.title: Read a Linked List Backwards
en.description:
A singly linked list in memory has n nodes numbered 0 to n-1. Each node stores an integer value and the number of the next node; the last node's next is -1. The nodes are described in no particular order, and you only know which node is the head.
Print the values from the tail node back to the head node.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 06. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and h (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 0 ≤ h < n): the node count and the head's number.
Each of the next n lines (the i-th, counting from 0) holds two integers v and nx: node i has value v (-10^9 ≤ v ≤ 10^9) and its next node is nx (-1 means none).
Following nx from the head visits all n nodes, each exactly once.
en.output: One line with n integers: the values from the tail to the head, separated by spaces.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the list is node 2 → node 0 → node 3 → node 1 with values 7, 5, -2, 9; backwards that is 9 -2 5 7.
Sample 2 has a single node.
hints: Walk the list once recording the order, then print it reversed; a stack works too, or recursion that prints on the way back.
On a long list recursion can overflow the call stack; the iterative version is safer.

problem.title: 用两个栈拼出一个队列
problem.description:
你手里只有“栈”这种数据结构：只能在一端压入和弹出。请用两个栈模拟一个先进先出的队列，支持两种操作：
push x：把整数 x 放到队尾；
pop：取出并输出队首元素；如果队列为空，输出 -1。
依次执行给定的操作。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 09。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 q（1 ≤ q ≤ 100000），表示操作个数。
接下来 q 行，每行是 push x（-10^9 ≤ x ≤ 10^9）或 pop。
problem.output: 对每个 pop 操作输出一行，为取出的值，或者 -1。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 先放入 1、2，取出 1；再放入 3，依次取出 2 和 3；最后队列已空，输出 -1。
hints: 一个栈只管入队，另一个栈只管出队。出队栈空了，再把入队栈里的元素全部倒过去，顺序就反过来了。
每个元素最多被倒一次，所以总时间是 O(q)。

en.title: A Queue Out of Two Stacks
en.description:
All you have are stacks: push and pop at one end only. Use two stacks to act as a first-in, first-out queue that supports:
push x: put the integer x at the back;
pop: remove and print the front element, or print -1 if the queue is empty.
Run the given operations in order.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 09. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 100000), the number of operations.
Each of the next q lines is push x (-10^9 ≤ x ≤ 10^9) or pop.
en.output: For each pop, print one line: the removed value or -1.
en.explanation: Sample 1 pushes 1 and 2 and pops 1; then it pushes 3 and pops 2 and 3; the queue is now empty, so the last pop prints -1.
hints: One stack takes the pushes, the other serves the pops. When the serving stack is empty, pour the whole first stack into it, which reverses the order.
Each element is poured at most once, so the total time is O(q).

problem.title: 斐波那契数取模
problem.description:
斐波那契数列定义为 F(0) = 0，F(1) = 1，当 n ≥ 2 时 F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)。
给出若干个询问，每个询问一个 n，请输出 F(n) 除以 1000000007 的余数。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 10-I。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 1000），表示询问个数。
第二行 t 个整数 n（0 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
problem.output: t 行，第 i 行是第 i 个询问的答案。
hints: 直接按定义递归会重复计算同一项，时间是指数级的。从小到大递推，每项只算一次。
询问很多时，可以先把 0 到最大 n 的答案都算出来再查表。每一步都取模，避免数字过大。

en.title: Fibonacci Modulo a Prime
en.description:
The Fibonacci sequence is F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1 and F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) for n ≥ 2.
For each query n, print F(n) modulo 1000000007.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 10-I. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000), the number of queries.
The second line holds t integers n (0 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
en.output: t lines; line i answers query i.
hints: Plain recursion recomputes the same terms and takes exponential time. Build the terms upward so each is computed once.
With many queries, compute every answer up to the largest n once and look them up. Reduce modulo at every step to keep numbers small.

problem.title: 扫地机器人能到达多少格
problem.description:
一块 m 行 n 列的地板，格子坐标从 (0, 0) 到 (m-1, n-1)。扫地机器人从 (0, 0) 出发，每次可以向上、下、左、右移动一格，不能离开地板。
有些格子被禁止进入：如果一个格子的行号各位数字之和加上列号各位数字之和大于 k，机器人就不能进入它。例如 k = 18 时，(35, 37) 可以进入，因为 3+5+3+7 = 18；(35, 38) 不能进入，因为 3+5+3+8 = 19。
请问机器人一共能到达多少个格子（包括起点）？

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 13。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行三个整数 m、n、k（1 ≤ m, n ≤ 300，0 ≤ k ≤ 40）。
problem.output: 一个整数，机器人能到达的格子数。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 是 2 行 3 列、k = 1：(0, 0)、(0, 1)、(1, 0) 的数位和不超过 1，能到达，共 3 格。
样例 2 中 k = 0，机器人只能待在起点。
hints: 满足数位和条件的格子不一定都能到达：中间可能被禁止的格子隔开。要从起点做 BFS 或 DFS。
行号可能有三位数，数位和要把每一位都加上。

en.title: How Far the Robot Vacuum Goes
en.description:
A floor has m rows and n columns, cells (0, 0) to (m-1, n-1). A robot vacuum starts at (0, 0) and moves one cell up, down, left or right at a time without leaving the floor.
Some cells are off limits: the robot cannot enter a cell whose row digit sum plus column digit sum is greater than k. For k = 18, cell (35, 37) is allowed because 3+5+3+7 = 18, and (35, 38) is not because 3+5+3+8 = 19.
How many cells can the robot reach, the start included?

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 13. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line with three integers m, n and k (1 ≤ m, n ≤ 300, 0 ≤ k ≤ 40).
en.output: One integer: the number of reachable cells.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 is 2 rows by 3 columns with k = 1: (0, 0), (0, 1) and (1, 0) have digit sums at most 1 and are reachable, 3 cells in all.
In sample 2, k = 0 and the robot stays at the start.
hints: Not every allowed cell is reachable: blocked cells can cut a region off. Search from the start with BFS or DFS.
Row numbers can have three digits; add every digit.

problem.title: 列出所有不超过 n 位的正整数
problem.description:
给定正整数 n，按从小到大的顺序输出所有位数不超过 n 的正整数，也就是从 1 一直到 n 个 9 组成的那个数。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 17。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 5）。
problem.output: 一行，从 1 开始的所有不超过 n 位的正整数，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: n = 1 时输出 1 到 9；n = 2 时输出 1 到 99。
hints: 本题的 n 很小，可以直接算出上界 10^n - 1。但如果 n 是几十甚至上百，任何整数类型都放不下，这时要用字符串表示数字：模拟“加一”并处理进位，或者把每一位当作 0 到 9 的全排列来生成，输出时去掉前导零。
注意上界是 10^n - 1，不包括 10^n，也不从 0 开始。

en.title: List Every Positive Number of at Most n Digits
en.description:
Given a positive integer n, print in increasing order every positive integer with at most n digits, that is, from 1 up to the number written as n nines.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 17. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 5).
en.output: One line: every positive integer with at most n digits, starting from 1, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: For n = 1 the output is 1 to 9; for n = 2 it is 1 to 99.
hints: Here n is small enough to compute the bound 10^n - 1 directly. If n were dozens or hundreds, no integer type could hold it; you would keep the number as a string and simulate adding one with carries, or generate every digit position from 0 to 9 recursively and drop leading zeros when printing.
The bound is 10^n - 1: 10^n itself is excluded, and 0 is not printed.

problem.title: 从链表里摘掉一个结点
problem.description:
一条单向链表上的结点值互不相同。给定其中一个结点的值 v，请把这个结点从链表中删掉，然后从头到尾输出剩下的链表。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 18。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000），表示结点个数。
第二行 n 个互不相同的整数，从头到尾依次是每个结点的值，绝对值不超过 10^9。
第三行一个整数 v，保证它是某个结点的值。
problem.output: 一行，删除之后链表从头到尾的值，以空格分隔。如果链表变空，输出一个空行。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 删掉值为 5 的结点，4 直接接到 1 前面。
样例 2 删掉的是头结点。
hints: 删除一个结点，就是让它的前一个结点直接指向它的后一个结点。
头结点没有“前一个结点”，可以在前面放一个哨兵结点统一处理；删除尾结点和链表只有一个结点的情况也要试一试。

en.title: Unlink One Node
en.description:
The values on a singly linked list are all distinct. Given the value v of one node, remove that node and print the rest of the list from head to tail.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 18. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000), the number of nodes.
The second line holds n distinct integers, the values from head to tail, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
The third line holds an integer v, the value of some node.
en.output: One line: the remaining values from head to tail, separated by spaces. If the list becomes empty, print an empty line.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 removes the node holding 5, so 4 now links straight to 1.
Sample 2 removes the head.
hints: Removing a node means pointing its predecessor at its successor.
The head has no predecessor; a sentinel node in front handles it like any other. Also try removing the tail and removing the only node.

problem.title: 这串字符是不是一个数
problem.description:
判断一个字符串能否看作一个十进制数值。合法的数值按顺序由下面几部分组成：
1. 可选的符号 + 或 -；
2. 一个整数或小数。整数是至少一位数字；小数是“若干数字、一个小数点、若干数字”，小数点两边至少有一边有数字（所以 3.、.5、3.14 都合法，单独的 . 不合法）；
3. 可选的指数部分：字母 e 或 E，后面紧跟一个整数，这个整数可以带一个符号 + 或 -，至少要有一位数字。
除此之外不允许出现任何其他字符。例如 +100、5e2、-123、3.1416、-1E-16、0123、.1、7. 都是数值；12e、1a3.14、1.2.3、+-5、12e+5.4、e9、inf 都不是。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 20。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 1000）。
接下来 t 行，每行一个字符串，长度在 1 到 40 之间，由数字、字母、+、-、. 等可见字符组成，不含空白字符。
problem.output: t 行，每行输出 true 或 false，表示对应的字符串是不是数值。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 的前六个字符串都是数值，后六个都不是：12e 的指数部分没有数字，1a3.14 含有字母 a，1.2.3 有两个小数点，+-5 有两个符号，12e+5.4 的指数不是整数，单独的 . 两边都没有数字。
hints: 按位置扫描：先吃掉符号，再吃掉数字和小数点并记录是否见过数字，然后处理 e/E 和它后面的部分，最后检查是否恰好走到末尾。
也可以画一个有限状态机。别直接调用语言自带的浮点解析，它们会接受 inf、nan 之类本题不认可的写法。

en.title: Is This String a Number?
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000).
Each of the next t lines holds a string of 1 to 40 visible characters (digits, letters, +, -, . and so on) without whitespace.
en.output: t lines, each true or false: whether the string is a number.
en.explanation: In sample 1 the first six strings are numbers and the last six are not: 12e has no exponent digits, 1a3.14 contains the letter a, 1.2.3 has two points, +-5 has two signs, 12e+5.4 has a non-integer exponent and a lone . has no digits on either side.
hints: Scan by position: take the sign, then digits and the point while noting whether any digit appeared, then e/E and what follows it, and finally check that you reached the end.
A finite-state machine works too. Avoid your language's float parser: it accepts spellings such as inf and nan that this problem rejects.

problem.title: 奇数排在偶数前面
problem.description:
给定一个整数数组，请重新排列：所有奇数放在前半部分，所有偶数放在后半部分。并且奇数之间、偶数之间都要保持原来的先后顺序。
注意负数也有奇偶之分，例如 -3 是奇数，-4 是偶数。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 21。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 一行 n 个整数，为重新排列后的数组，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 的奇数依次是 1、3、5，偶数依次是 2、4，所以答案是 1 3 5 2 4。
样例 2 中 -3 和 -1 是奇数，保持原顺序排在前面。
hints: 两遍扫描最直接：先收集奇数，再收集偶数。
判断奇偶时，很多语言里负数取模得到负数（-3 % 2 等于 -1），写成 x % 2 == 1 会把负奇数当成偶数，可以改用 x % 2 != 0 或位运算 x & 1。

en.title: Odd Numbers First
en.description:
Rearrange an integer array so that all odd numbers come first and all even numbers after them, keeping the original relative order among the odd numbers and among the even numbers.
Negative numbers have a parity too: -3 is odd and -4 is even.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 21. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One line with the n rearranged integers, separated by spaces.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the odd numbers are 1, 3, 5 in order and the even ones 2, 4, so the answer is 1 3 5 2 4.
In sample 2, -3 and -1 are odd and keep their order at the front.
hints: Two passes are the simplest: collect the odd numbers, then the even ones.
In many languages a negative number modulo 2 is negative (-3 % 2 is -1), so x % 2 == 1 treats negative odd numbers as even. Use x % 2 != 0 or x & 1.

problem.title: 链表的最后 k 个结点
problem.description:
给定一条单向链表和正整数 k，请输出从倒数第 k 个结点开始一直到链表末尾的所有结点值。尾结点是倒数第 1 个。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 22。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，从头到尾依次是每个结点的值，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 一行 k 个整数，从倒数第 k 个结点到尾结点的值，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 的链表是 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5，倒数第 2 个结点的值是 4，所以输出 4 5。
hints: 用两个指针：快指针先走 k 步，然后两个指针一起走，快指针走到末尾时，慢指针正好停在倒数第 k 个结点上。只需遍历一次。
注意边界：k 等于 n 时答案是整条链表，k 等于 1 时只有尾结点。

en.title: The Last k Nodes of a List
en.description:
Given a singly linked list and a positive integer k, print the values from the k-th node from the end through the tail. The tail is the 1st node from the end.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 22. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and k (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, the values from head to tail, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One line with k integers: the values from the k-th node from the end to the tail, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: In sample 1 the list is 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5; the 2nd node from the end holds 4, so the output is 4 5.
hints: Use two pointers: move the fast one k steps ahead, then move both until the fast one falls off the end; the slow one sits on the k-th node from the end after a single pass.
Check the edges: k = n is the whole list and k = 1 is just the tail.

problem.title: 一棵树能否拼进另一棵树
problem.description:
给定两棵二叉树 A 和 B。如果能在 A 中找到一个结点，把 B 的根对准它往下比对：B 的每个结点在 A 中对应位置上都有结点，且值相等，就说 B 是 A 的一个子结构。
注意 B 只需要和 A 的一部分重合，A 中对应位置下面多出来的结点不影响结果；这和“子树”要求整棵子树完全相同是不一样的。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 26。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 两行，第一行描述树 A，第二行描述树 B。每棵树按层序给出结点值，空结点写作 null，末尾的 null 省略。两棵树都至少有一个结点，A 最多 10000 个结点，B 最多 1000 个结点，结点值是绝对值不超过 1000 的整数（可能重复）。
problem.output: 如果 B 是 A 的子结构，输出 true，否则输出 false。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 A 的根的左孩子是 4，它的两个孩子是 1 和 2，正好能放下 B（根 4，左孩子 1），所以输出 true；虽然 A 里的 4 还多一个孩子 2，但不影响。
样例 2 中 B 的根 3 只能对准 A 的根，而 A 的根的左孩子是 4，不是 B 要求的 1，所以输出 false。
hints: 两层递归：外层遍历 A 的每个结点作为候选起点，内层从这个起点开始和 B 同步往下比对。
内层比对时，B 走到空结点就算匹配成功；B 不空而 A 空，或两者值不同，就失败。

en.title: Does One Tree Fit Inside Another?
en.description:
Given two binary trees A and B, B is a substructure of A if some node of A can serve as B's root so that, comparing downward, every node of B has a node in the matching position of A with the same value.
B only has to overlap part of A: extra nodes of A below the matched positions do not matter. That differs from a subtree, which must match a whole subtree exactly.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 26. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: Two lines describing tree A and then tree B. Each tree lists its values in level order, with null for a missing child and trailing nulls left out. Both trees have at least one node; A has at most 10000 nodes and B at most 1000. Values are integers with absolute value at most 1000 and may repeat.
en.output: Print true if B is a substructure of A, otherwise false.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, the root of A has left child 4 whose children are 1 and 2, which holds B (root 4 with left child 1), so the answer is true; the extra child 2 does not matter.
In sample 2, B's root 3 can only sit on A's root, whose left child is 4 rather than the 1 that B needs, so the answer is false.
hints: Two levels of recursion: the outer one tries every node of A as a starting point, the inner one walks A and B together from there.
In the inner walk, reaching an empty node of B is a match; a non-empty B node facing an empty A node, or a different value, is a failure.

problem.title: 按层遍历二叉树
problem.description:
一棵二叉树有 n 个结点，编号为 1 到 n。请从上到下、同一层从左到右地依次输出每个结点的值。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 32-I。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 root（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，1 ≤ root ≤ n），表示结点数和根结点的编号。
接下来 n 行，第 i 行三个整数 v、l、r，表示 i 号结点的值为 v（绝对值不超过 10^9），左孩子编号为 l，右孩子编号为 r；没有孩子时写 0。保证输入构成一棵以 root 为根的二叉树。
problem.output: 一行 n 个整数，为按层遍历的结果，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 中根是 2 号结点（值 3），它的左孩子 1 号（值 9）、右孩子 4 号（值 20），4 号的两个孩子是 3 号（值 15）和 5 号（值 7）。按层输出就是 3 9 20 15 7。
hints: 用队列：先放入根，每次取出队首结点输出，再把它的左、右孩子依次放到队尾。
递归的先序遍历不是按层的顺序。

en.title: Walk a Binary Tree Level by Level
en.description:
A binary tree has n nodes numbered 1 to n. Print the node values from top to bottom, and from left to right within each level.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 32-I. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and root (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 1 ≤ root ≤ n): the node count and the root's number.
Line i of the next n lines holds three integers v, l and r: node i has value v (absolute value at most 10^9), left child l and right child r, with 0 meaning no child. The input forms a binary tree rooted at root.
en.output: One line with the n values in level order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: In sample 1 the root is node 2 (value 3); its left child is node 1 (value 9) and its right child node 4 (value 20), whose children are node 3 (value 15) and node 5 (value 7). Level by level that reads 3 9 20 15 7.
hints: Use a queue: start with the root; take the front node, print it, and append its left and right children.
A recursive preorder walk does not give level order.

problem.title: 检验二叉搜索树的后序序列
problem.description:
二叉搜索树中，每个结点左子树的值都比它小，右子树的值都比它大。后序遍历按“左子树、右子树、根”的顺序访问结点。
给定一个各元素互不相同的整数序列，判断它是否可能是某棵二叉搜索树的后序遍历结果。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 33。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 10），表示序列个数。
接下来每个序列占两行：第一行是长度 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 2000），第二行是 n 个互不相同的整数，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: t 行，每行输出 true 或 false。
problem.explanation:
第一个序列 1 3 2 6 5 是以 5 为根、左子树 {1, 3, 2}、右子树 {6} 的树的后序遍历，所以是 true。
第二个序列 1 6 3 2 5：根是 5，从左往右第一个比 5 大的是 6，所以左子树只有 {1}，右子树是 {6, 3, 2}，但 3 和 2 比根小，不可能在右子树里，所以是 false。
hints: 最后一个数是根。从左往右找到第一个比根大的位置，前面是左子树、后面到根之前是右子树；右子树里不能出现比根小的数。然后对两部分递归检查。
也可以用单调栈在 O(n) 时间内倒着扫描完成。

en.title: Check a Search Tree's Postorder Sequence
en.description:
In a binary search tree, every value in a node's left subtree is smaller than the node and every value in its right subtree is larger. A postorder walk visits the left subtree, then the right subtree, then the root.
Given a sequence of distinct integers, decide whether it can be the postorder walk of some binary search tree.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 33. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10), the number of sequences.
Each sequence takes two lines: its length n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000), then n distinct integers with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: t lines, each true or false.
en.explanation:
The first sequence 1 3 2 6 5 is the postorder walk of the tree rooted at 5 with left subtree {1, 3, 2} and right subtree {6}, so it is true.
In the second sequence 1 6 3 2 5 the root is 5; the first value larger than 5 from the left is 6, so the left subtree is just {1} and the right subtree {6, 3, 2}. But 3 and 2 are smaller than the root and cannot be in the right subtree, so it is false.
hints: The last value is the root. The first value larger than it splits the rest: before it is the left subtree, from it up to the root the right subtree, which must hold no value smaller than the root. Then check both parts recursively.
A monotonic stack scanning backwards does it in O(n).

problem.title: 字符串的全部排列
problem.description:
给定一个由小写字母组成的字符串（可能有重复字母），请列出把它的字母重新排列能得到的所有不同字符串。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 38。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行字符串，长度在 1 到 8 之间。
problem.output: 按字典序从小到大，每行输出一个排列，相同的排列只输出一次。
problem.explanation: abc 有 6 种排列；aab 只有 aab、aba、baa 三种不同的排列。
hints: 回溯：依次决定每个位置放哪个字母。先把字母排序，同一层里遇到和上一个相同、而上一个刚刚被撤销的字母时跳过，就不会产生重复。
也可以从最小的排列开始，反复求“下一个排列”，天然就是字典序。

en.title: Every Arrangement of a String
en.description:
Given a string of lowercase letters (letters may repeat), list every distinct string obtained by rearranging its letters.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 38. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line with the string, of length 1 to 8.
en.output: The arrangements in increasing lexicographic order, one per line, each distinct arrangement once.
en.explanation: abc has 6 arrangements; aab has only three distinct ones: aab, aba and baa.
hints: Backtrack, choosing a letter for each position in turn. Sort the letters first and, at one level, skip a letter equal to the previous one when that previous one has just been undone; no duplicates arise.
Or start from the smallest arrangement and repeatedly compute the next permutation, which is lexicographic order by construction.

problem.title: 最小的 k 个数
problem.description:
给定 n 个整数和正整数 k，请找出其中最小的 k 个数，按从小到大的顺序输出。相同的数按出现次数计算，例如 1 出现两次，可以同时出现在答案里。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 40。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 一行 k 个整数，从小到大排列，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中最小的两个数是 1 和 2。
样例 2 中 0 出现了两次，最小的三个数是 0 0 3。
hints: 排序后取前 k 个是 O(n log n)。用大小为 k 的大顶堆维护“目前最小的 k 个数”是 O(n log k)；快速选择的平均时间是 O(n)。
读入的数要按整数比较，不要按字符串比较（字符串比较下 "10" 小于 "9"）。

en.title: The k Smallest Numbers
en.description:
Given n integers and a positive integer k, find the k smallest of them and print them in increasing order. Equal values count separately: if 1 appears twice, both copies may be in the answer.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 40. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and k (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One line with k integers in increasing order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the two smallest numbers are 1 and 2.
In sample 2, 0 appears twice, so the three smallest are 0 0 3.
hints: Sorting and taking the first k costs O(n log n). A max-heap of size k holding the smallest k so far costs O(n log k); quickselect averages O(n).
Compare the numbers as integers, not as strings ("10" sorts before "9" as text).

problem.title: 拼出最小的数
problem.description:
给定若干个非负整数，把它们全部首尾相接拼成一个数字串，每个数恰好用一次、顺序任意。请输出能拼出的字典序最小的数字串（所有结果长度相同，所以也就是数值最小的那个）。前导零保留，不要删除。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 45。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，每个在 0 到 10^9 之间。
problem.output: 一行，拼出的最小数字串。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 3 和 30 有两种拼法：330 和 303，303 更小，所以 30 要放在 3 前面。答案是 3033459。
样例 2 拼出 0012，前导零保留。
hints: 对两个数 a、b，如果拼接 ab 小于 ba，a 就应该排在 b 前面。按这个规则排序后依次拼接即可，这个比较规则满足传递性。
直接按字符串字典序排序是错的：3 排在 30 前面会得到 330。

en.title: Build the Smallest Number
en.description:
Given some non-negative integers, write all of them end to end as one digit string, each exactly once in any order. Print the lexicographically smallest string you can build (every result has the same length, so this is also the smallest value). Keep leading zeros.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 45. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, each between 0 and 10^9.
en.output: One line: the smallest digit string.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, 3 and 30 join as 330 or 303, and 303 is smaller, so 30 goes before 3. The answer is 3033459.
Sample 2 builds 0012 and keeps the leading zeros.
hints: For two numbers a and b, put a first when the joined string ab is smaller than ba. Sort with that rule and join; the rule is transitive.
Plain lexicographic sorting is wrong: putting 3 before 30 gives 330.

problem.title: 数字串能译成多少种字母串
problem.description:
约定把 0 译成 a，1 译成 b，……，25 译成 z。一串数字可以切成若干段，每段是一位数字 0~9，或者两位数字 10~25，再逐段翻译。注意两位的一段不能以 0 开头，例如 05 不能当作一段。
给定一串数字，求一共有多少种不同的翻译结果。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 46。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行，一个由数字组成的字符串，长度在 1 到 60 之间（可能以 0 开头）。
problem.output: 一个整数，表示翻译方法的数量。
problem.explanation:
12258 有 5 种译法：1 2 2 5 8 → bccfi，1 22 5 8 → bwfi，1 2 25 8 → bczi，12 2 5 8 → mcfi，12 25 8 → mzi。
506 只有一种：5 0 6，因为 50 和 06 都不能作为一段。
hints: 设 f(i) 是前 i 位的译法数：最后一位单独成段，贡献 f(i-1)；如果最后两位在 10 到 25 之间，还能贡献 f(i-2)。
这和爬楼梯很像，只用两个变量就能滚动计算。答案可能超过 32 位整数的范围。

en.title: Ways to Read Digits as Letters
en.description:
Read 0 as a, 1 as b, …, 25 as z. A digit string is cut into pieces, each a single digit 0–9 or two digits 10–25, and every piece becomes one letter. A two-digit piece cannot start with 0, so 05 is not a piece.
Given a digit string, count the different letter strings it can be read as.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 46. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line: a string of 1 to 60 digits (it may start with 0).
en.output: One integer: the number of readings.
en.explanation:
12258 has 5 readings: 1 2 2 5 8 → bccfi, 1 22 5 8 → bwfi, 1 2 25 8 → bczi, 12 2 5 8 → mcfi and 12 25 8 → mzi.
506 has one: 5 0 6, since neither 50 nor 06 is a piece.
hints: Let f(i) count the readings of the first i digits: the last digit alone contributes f(i-1), and when the last two digits are between 10 and 25 they add f(i-2).
It works like climbing stairs and needs only two rolling variables. The count can exceed a 32-bit integer.

problem.title: 捡金币的最大收获
problem.description:
一个 m 行 n 列的棋盘，每格放着若干枚金币。你从左上角出发，每一步只能向右或向下走一格，直到走到右下角，沿途（包括起点和终点）每一格的金币都会被你捡起。最多能捡到多少枚金币？

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 47。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 m 和 n（1 ≤ m, n ≤ 200）。
接下来 m 行，每行 n 个整数，表示每格的金币数，在 0 到 1000 之间。
problem.output: 一个整数，最多能捡到的金币数。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 中，路线 1 → 3 → 5 → 2 → 1 能捡到 12 枚，没有更多的走法。
hints: 走到一格的最优收获，等于这一格的金币加上它上方和左方两格的最优收获中较大的那个。第一行和第一列只有一个来源，要沿着累加。
每一步都挑相邻两格中金币多的走法（贪心）不一定最优。

en.title: Most Coins on the Way Down
en.description:
An m by n board has some coins on every cell. You start at the top-left cell and move one cell right or down at a time until you reach the bottom-right cell, picking up the coins on every cell you visit (start and end included). What is the largest number of coins you can collect?

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 47. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers m and n (1 ≤ m, n ≤ 200).
Each of the next m lines holds n integers, the coins on each cell, between 0 and 1000.
en.output: One integer: the most coins you can collect.
en.explanation: In sample 1 the route 1 → 3 → 5 → 2 → 1 collects 12 coins, and no route collects more.
hints: The best total on arrival at a cell is its coins plus the larger best total of the cell above and the cell to the left. The first row and column have a single way in and accumulate along it.
Always stepping toward the richer neighbour (greedy) is not always best.

problem.title: 第一个落单的字母
problem.description:
给定一个由小写字母组成的字符串，从左往右看，找出第一个在整个字符串里只出现一次的字母。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 50。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行字符串，长度在 1 到 100000 之间，只含小写字母。
problem.output: 第一个只出现一次的字母；如果每个字母都出现了不止一次，输出 none。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 a 出现了两次，b 只出现一次，所以答案是 b。
样例 2 中每个字母都出现了两次。
hints: 扫描两遍：第一遍统计每个字母的出现次数，第二遍按原顺序找第一个次数为 1 的字母。
只看“后面有没有再出现”是不够的，前面出现过的字母同样不算落单。

en.title: The First Letter That Appears Once
en.description:
Given a string of lowercase letters, read it from the left and find the first letter that occurs exactly once in the whole string.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 50. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line: a string of 1 to 100000 lowercase letters.
en.output: The first letter that appears once; if every letter appears more than once, print none.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, a appears twice and b once, so the answer is b.
In sample 2 every letter appears twice.
hints: Two passes: count every letter, then scan in order for the first letter whose count is 1.
Checking only whether the letter occurs again later is not enough; a letter seen earlier is not alone either.

problem.title: 统计逆序对
problem.description:
在一个整数数组里，如果 i < j 且第 i 个数严格大于第 j 个数，就称这两个数构成一个逆序对。给定数组，求逆序对的总数。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 51。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 一个整数，逆序对的个数。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 的数组 7 5 6 4 中，逆序对有 (7,5)、(7,6)、(7,4)、(5,4)、(6,4)，共 5 个。
样例 2 的数组 3 2 2 中，3 和后面的两个 2 各构成一对；两个 2 相等，不算逆序对，所以答案是 2。
hints: 两重循环是 O(n^2)，太慢。归并排序合并两个有序段时，每当右段的数先被放下，左段里剩下的数都比它大，可以一次数出一批逆序对。也可以离散化后用树状数组。
相等的两个数不算逆序对。答案最大约为 5×10^9，超出 32 位整数的范围。

en.title: Count Inversions
en.description:
In an integer array, positions i < j form an inversion when the value at i is strictly greater than the value at j. Count the inversions of the given array.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 51. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One integer: the number of inversions.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the array 7 5 6 4 has the inversions (7,5), (7,6), (7,4), (5,4) and (6,4): 5 in all.
In sample 2 the array 3 2 2 pairs 3 with each of the two 2s; the two equal 2s do not count, so the answer is 2.
hints: Two nested loops take O(n^2), which is too slow. While merge sort merges two sorted halves, whenever a value from the right half goes first, every value left in the left half is larger, so a whole batch is counted at once. A Fenwick tree over compressed values works too.
Equal values are not an inversion. The answer can reach about 5×10^9, beyond a 32-bit integer.

problem.title: 有序数组里的出现次数
problem.description:
给定一个按非递减顺序排好的整数数组，以及 q 个询问，每个询问一个整数 x，请回答 x 在数组中出现了多少次。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 53-I。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 q（1 ≤ n, q ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个按非递减顺序排列的整数，绝对值不超过 10^9。
第三行 q 个整数，表示每个询问的 x，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: q 行，第 i 行是第 i 个询问的答案。
problem.explanation: 数组 5 7 7 8 8 10 中，8 出现 2 次，6 没有出现，10 出现 1 次，7 出现 2 次。
hints: 两次二分查找：一次找第一个不小于 x 的位置，一次找第一个大于 x 的位置，两者之差就是出现次数。每个询问 O(log n)。
找到一个 x 之后再向两边逐个数，最坏情况下每个询问都是 O(n)。

en.title: Occurrences in a Sorted Array
en.description:
Given an integer array sorted in non-decreasing order and q queries, each an integer x, answer how many times x appears in the array.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 53-I. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and q (1 ≤ n, q ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers in non-decreasing order, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
The third line holds the q query values x, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: q lines; line i answers query i.
en.explanation: In the array 5 7 7 8 8 10, 8 appears 2 times, 6 never, 10 once and 7 twice.
hints: Two binary searches: the first position not less than x and the first position greater than x; their difference is the count. Each query costs O(log n).
Finding one x and then counting outward one by one costs O(n) per query in the worst case.

problem.title: 少了哪个编号
problem.description:
0 到 n 这 n+1 个整数里恰好少了一个，剩下的 n 个按从小到大的顺序排成一个数组。请找出少掉的那个数。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 53-II。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个严格递增的整数，都在 0 到 n 之间。
problem.output: 一个整数，被去掉的那个数。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 是 0 1 3，少了 2。
样例 2 是 0 1 2 3，少的是最后一个数 4。
hints: 少掉的数之前，每个位置的值都等于下标；从它开始，值都比下标大 1。用二分查找第一个“值不等于下标”的位置，时间 O(log n)。
别忘了少掉的可能是 0，也可能是 n。

en.title: Which Label Is Missing?
en.description:
Exactly one of the n+1 integers 0 to n is missing; the other n are given in increasing order. Find the missing one.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 53-II. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n strictly increasing integers between 0 and n.
en.output: One integer: the missing number.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 is 0 1 3, missing 2.
Sample 2 is 0 1 2 3, missing the last number, 4.
hints: Before the gap every value equals its index; from the gap on, every value is one more. Binary search for the first index whose value differs, in O(log n).
The missing number can be 0, and it can be n.

problem.title: 搜索树里第 k 大的值
problem.description:
给定一棵二叉搜索树（结点值互不相同，左子树都比结点小，右子树都比结点大）和正整数 k，求树中第 k 大的结点值。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 54。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行按层序给出这棵树：结点值以空格分隔，空结点写作 null，末尾的 null 省略。树有 1 到 10000 个结点，结点值是绝对值不超过 10^9 的整数。
第二行一个整数 k（1 ≤ k ≤ 结点数）。
problem.output: 一个整数，第 k 大的结点值。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 的树中值从大到小是 6、5、4、3、2、1，第 3 大的是 4。
hints: 中序遍历（左、根、右）按从小到大访问结点；反过来按“右、根、左”遍历就是从大到小，数到第 k 个就可以停下。
树可能退化成一条链，深度可达 10000，递归写法要注意栈深度，也可以用显式栈。

en.title: The k-th Largest Value in a Search Tree
en.description:
Given a binary search tree (distinct values; the left subtree is smaller than the node and the right subtree larger) and a positive integer k, find the k-th largest value in the tree.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 54. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line gives the tree in level order: values separated by spaces, null for a missing child, trailing nulls left out. The tree has 1 to 10000 nodes with integer values of absolute value at most 10^9.
The second line holds an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ the number of nodes).
en.output: One integer: the k-th largest value.
en.explanation: In sample 1 the values from largest to smallest are 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, so the 3rd largest is 4.
hints: An inorder walk (left, node, right) visits values in increasing order; walking right, node, left visits them in decreasing order, and you can stop at the k-th.
The tree can be a single path 10000 deep; watch the recursion depth or use an explicit stack.

problem.title: 有序数组里凑出目标和
problem.description:
给定一个按非递减顺序排列的整数数组和目标值 s，请在数组中找两个不同位置上的数 a 和 b（a ≤ b），使 a + b = s。如果有多组，输出 a 最小的那一组；如果没有，输出 -1。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 57。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 s（2 ≤ n ≤ 100000，1 ≤ s ≤ 2×10^6）。
第二行 n 个按非递减顺序排列的整数，每个在 1 到 10^6 之间。
problem.output: 找到时输出一行两个整数 a b；找不到时输出 -1。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 2 + 7 = 9，也有 4 + 5 = 9，a 最小的是 2 7。
样例 2 中想凑出 6 需要两个 3，但数组里只有一个 3，所以输出 -1。
hints: 双指针：一个从左端出发，一个从右端出发。和太大就把右指针左移，和太小就把左指针右移。可以证明这样找到的第一组就是 a 最小的。
同一个位置的数不能用两次。

en.title: Two Numbers That Hit the Target in a Sorted Array
en.description:
Given an integer array in non-decreasing order and a target s, find numbers a and b at two different positions (a ≤ b) with a + b = s. If several pairs work, print the one with the smallest a; if none does, print -1.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 57. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and s (2 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 1 ≤ s ≤ 2×10^6).
The second line holds n integers in non-decreasing order, each from 1 to 10^6.
en.output: One line with a b when a pair exists, otherwise -1.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, 2 + 7 = 9 and 4 + 5 = 9; the one with the smallest a is 2 7.
In sample 2, making 6 needs two 3s, but the array has only one, so the answer is -1.
hints: Two pointers, one from each end: move the right one left when the sum is too large, the left one right when it is too small. The first pair found this way has the smallest a.
The number at one position cannot be used twice.

problem.title: 连续正整数凑出目标和
problem.description:
给定正整数 target，找出所有由至少两个连续正整数组成、总和恰好等于 target 的序列。例如 15 = 1+2+3+4+5 = 4+5+6 = 7+8。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 57-II。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一个整数 target（1 ≤ target ≤ 100000）。
problem.output:
第一行一个整数 k，表示序列个数。
接下来 k 行，每行一个序列，从小到大列出其中的数，以空格分隔。各序列按首项从小到大排列。
problem.explanation:
样例 1：9 = 2+3+4 = 4+5，共两个序列，首项小的在前。
样例 2：4 没有这样的序列，只输出 0。
hints: 滑动窗口：用左右两个端点维护当前连续段的和，和小了右端点右移，和大了左端点右移，相等就记录下来。
也可以枚举序列长度 len：首项 = (target - len(len-1)/2) / len，必须是正整数。

en.title: Consecutive Positive Integers That Sum to a Target
en.description:
Given a positive integer target, find every run of at least two consecutive positive integers that sums to exactly target. For example 15 = 1+2+3+4+5 = 4+5+6 = 7+8.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 57-II. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One integer target (1 ≤ target ≤ 100000).
en.output:
The first line holds k, the number of runs.
Each of the next k lines lists one run in increasing order, separated by spaces. Runs are ordered by their first number, smallest first.
en.explanation:
Sample 1: 9 = 2+3+4 = 4+5, two runs with the smaller first number first.
Sample 2: 4 has no such run, so the output is just 0.
hints: Sliding window: keep the sum of the current run between two ends; grow the right end when the sum is too small, shrink from the left when it is too large, and record it when equal.
Or try every length len: the first number is (target - len(len-1)/2) / len and must be a positive integer.

problem.title: 把字符串的开头搬到末尾
problem.description:
给定一个字符串 s 和非负整数 k，把 s 开头的字符依次搬到末尾，一共搬 k 次，输出最后得到的字符串。搬满一圈之后字符串会复原，所以 k 可能远大于 s 的长度。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 58-II。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个字符串 s，长度在 1 到 10000 之间，只含字母和数字。
第二行一个整数 k（0 ≤ k ≤ 10^9）。
problem.output: 一行，搬动之后的字符串。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 把 ab 搬到 cdefg 的后面，得到 cdefgab。
样例 2 的长度是 5，搬 7 次和搬 2 次的效果一样。
hints: 先让 k 对长度取模，答案就是 s 从第 k 位开始的后半段接上前 k 位。
不借助额外字符串也能做：把前 k 位翻转，把剩下的翻转，再把整个串翻转。

en.title: Move the Front of a String to the Back
en.description:
Given a string s and a non-negative integer k, move the first character of s to the end, k times in all, and print the result. After a full lap the string is back as it was, so k may be far larger than the length of s.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 58-II. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds s: 1 to 10000 letters and digits.
The second line holds an integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ 10^9).
en.output: One line: the string after the moves.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 moves ab behind cdefg, giving cdefgab.
In sample 2 the length is 5, so 7 moves act like 2.
hints: Reduce k modulo the length; the answer is s from position k on, followed by its first k characters.
Without an extra string: reverse the first k characters, reverse the rest, then reverse the whole string.

problem.title: 能随时报出最大值的队列
problem.description:
实现一个整数队列，支持三种操作：
push x：把 x 放到队尾；
pop：取出并输出队首元素，队列为空时输出 -1；
max：输出队列中当前的最大值，队列为空时输出 -1。
请依次执行给定的操作，每个操作的均摊时间应为 O(1)。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 59-II。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 q（1 ≤ q ≤ 100000）。
接下来 q 行，每行是 push x（1 ≤ x ≤ 10^9）、pop 或 max 中的一种。
problem.output: 对每个 pop 和 max 操作输出一行结果。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 先放入 1 和 2，最大值是 2；取出 1 后最大值还是 2；再取出 2，队列变空，max 输出 -1。
hints: 另外维护一个双端队列，里面的值从队首到队尾单调不增：放入 x 时，先把末尾比 x 小的都删掉。它的队首就是最大值。
弹出元素时，如果它等于辅助队列的队首，就把辅助队列的队首也弹出。所以放入时只能删掉严格更小的值，相等的值要保留。

en.title: A Queue That Knows Its Maximum
en.input:
The first line holds an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 100000).
Each of the next q lines is push x (1 ≤ x ≤ 10^9), pop or max.
en.output: One line for each pop and each max.
en.explanation: Sample 1 pushes 1 and 2, so the maximum is 2; after popping 1 it is still 2; popping 2 empties the queue and max prints -1.
hints: Keep a second double-ended queue whose values never increase from front to back: before pushing x onto it, drop the values at its back that are smaller than x. Its front is the maximum.
When the popped element equals the helper's front, pop the helper too. So pushing may drop only strictly smaller values; equal ones must stay.

problem.title: 掷 n 个骰子的点数分布
problem.description:
同时掷 n 个均匀的六面骰子，每个骰子等可能地掷出 1 到 6 点。把所有骰子的点数加起来，和的取值从 n 到 6n。请依次求出和为 n、n+1、……、6n 的概率。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 60。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 11）。
problem.output: 一行：先输出 5n+1，表示后面有多少个概率；再按和从小到大输出每个和出现的概率。与标准答案的误差不超过 10^-5 即视为正确。
problem.explanation:
一个骰子时，6 种点数的概率都是 1/6 ≈ 0.16667。
两个骰子时一共 36 种等可能的结果：和为 2 只有 (1,1) 一种，概率 1/36 ≈ 0.02778；和为 7 有 6 种，概率 6/36 ≈ 0.16667。
hints: 动态规划：已知 i 个骰子每个和的方案数，再加一个骰子，和为 s 的方案数等于 i 个骰子和为 s-1 到 s-6 的方案数之和。
最后把方案数除以 6^n。也可以直接用概率递推，每加一个骰子把每个概率乘以 1/6 分到后面 6 个位置。

en.title: How n Dice Add Up
en.description:
Roll n fair six-sided dice at once; each shows 1 to 6 with equal chance. Their total ranges from n to 6n. Give the probability of each total n, n+1, …, 6n.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 60. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 11).
en.output: One line: first 5n+1, the number of probabilities that follow, then the probability of each total from the smallest up. Answers within 10^-5 of the reference are accepted.
en.explanation:
With one die, each of the 6 faces has probability 1/6 ≈ 0.16667.
Two dice have 36 equally likely outcomes: a total of 2 comes only from (1,1), probability 1/36 ≈ 0.02778, and a total of 7 from 6 outcomes, probability 6/36 ≈ 0.16667.
hints: Dynamic programming: from the ways to roll each total with i dice, adding one die makes the ways for total s the sum of the ways for s-1 down to s-6 with i dice.
Divide the ways by 6^n at the end, or work with probabilities directly, spreading each one times 1/6 over the next 6 totals for every new die.

problem.title: 五张牌能否连成顺子
problem.description:
从扑克牌里抽出 5 张，A 记作 1，J、Q、K 分别记作 11、12、13，大小王记作 0，大小王可以当作任意一张牌使用。如果这 5 张牌能组成 5 个连续的点数（例如 3 4 5 6 7），就称为顺子。注意 A 只能当 1 用，不能接在 K 后面。
给定若干手牌，判断每手牌是不是顺子。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 61。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 10000）。
接下来 t 行，每行 5 个整数，每个在 0 到 13 之间，表示一手牌（大小王最多两张）。
problem.output: t 行，每行输出 true 或 false。
problem.explanation: 1 2 3 4 5 本身就是顺子；0 0 1 2 5 用两张王补上 3 和 4 也是顺子；1 2 2 4 5 有两张 2，不可能是顺子；0 1 2 3 7 中 1 到 7 跨度太大，一张王补不上。
hints: 不看王，剩下的牌不能有重复，并且最大值减最小值要小于 5。
算最小值时别把王的 0 也算进去。

en.title: Can Five Cards Make a Straight?
en.description:
Draw 5 playing cards: A is 1, J, Q and K are 11, 12 and 13, and the two jokers are 0 and can stand in for any card. The 5 cards form a straight if they can make 5 consecutive ranks (such as 3 4 5 6 7). An A is only 1 and cannot follow K.
For each given hand, decide whether it is a straight.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 61. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10000).
Each of the next t lines holds 5 integers from 0 to 13, one hand (at most two jokers).
en.output: t lines, each true or false.
en.explanation: 1 2 3 4 5 is a straight as it stands; 0 0 1 2 5 uses the two jokers as 3 and 4; 1 2 2 4 5 has two 2s and cannot be one; in 0 1 2 3 7 the span from 1 to 7 is too wide for one joker.
hints: Ignoring jokers, the remaining cards must have no repeats and their maximum minus minimum must be less than 5.
Leave the jokers' 0 out of the minimum.

problem.title: 围成一圈报数，最后剩下谁
problem.description:
n 个人围成一圈，编号依次为 0 到 n-1。从 0 号开始报数，报到 m 的人出圈，下一个人重新从 1 开始报数，如此反复，直到只剩一个人。请问最后剩下的人的编号是多少？
有多组数据。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 62。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 10）。
接下来 t 行，每行两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，1 ≤ m ≤ 10^6）。
problem.output: t 行，每行是对应那组数据最后剩下的编号。
problem.explanation:
n = 5、m = 3 时，出圈顺序是 2、0、4、1，最后剩下 3。
n = 10、m = 17 时，最后剩下 2。
hints: 直接模拟删除，每删一次都要在环里数 m 步，太慢。
递推：设 f(i) 是 i 个人时最后剩下的编号（从 0 起算），则 f(1) = 0，f(i) = (f(i-1) + m) mod i。注意这里取模用的是当前的人数 i，而不是 n。

en.title: Who Is Left in the Circle?
en.description:
n people stand in a circle numbered 0 to n-1. Counting starts at person 0; whoever says m leaves, and the next person starts again from 1. This repeats until one person is left. What is that person's number?
There are several test cases.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 62. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10).
Each of the next t lines holds two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 1 ≤ m ≤ 10^6).
en.output: t lines, the number of the last person for each case.
en.explanation:
For n = 5 and m = 3 people leave in the order 2, 0, 4, 1, and 3 is left.
For n = 10 and m = 17 the last one is 2.
hints: Simulating the removals counts m steps around the circle each time, which is too slow.
Recurrence: with f(i) the survivor among i people (counted from 0), f(1) = 0 and f(i) = (f(i-1) + m) mod i. The modulus is the current count i, not n.

problem.title: 从 1 加到 n
problem.description:
给出若干个询问，每个询问一个正整数 n，请输出 1 + 2 + … + n 的值。
原书的这道题额外要求不用乘除法、不用循环和条件判断来实现，这里不做强制，但你可以挑战一下：比如利用逻辑运算的短路特性来结束递归。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 64。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 100000）。
第二行 t 个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^9）。
problem.output: t 行，每行是对应询问的和。
hints: 公式是 n(n+1)/2。n 最大是 10^9，结果约为 5×10^17，要用 64 位整数，而且要先转成 64 位再相乘。
若想挑战原书限制：递归函数里写 n > 1 && (sum = n + f(n-1))，靠短路在 n = 1 时停止；但本题的 n 很大，只能用公式或者位运算模拟乘法。

en.title: Add 1 Through n
en.description:
For each query, a positive integer n, print 1 + 2 + … + n.
In the book this problem also forbids multiplication, division, loops and conditionals. That is not enforced here, but you can take it on, for instance by ending a recursion with a short-circuiting logical operator.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 64. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100000).
The second line holds t integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^9).
en.output: t lines, the sum for each query.
hints: The formula is n(n+1)/2. With n up to 10^9 the result is about 5×10^17, so use 64-bit integers and widen before multiplying.

For the book's restriction: a recursive function can write n > 1 && (sum = n + f(n-1)), which stops at n = 1 by short-circuiting; with n this large, though, you need the formula or multiplication built from bit operations.

problem.title: 字符各不相同吗
problem.description:
给出若干个字符串，判断每个字符串里的字符是否互不相同（大小写不同的字母算不同字符）。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 01.01。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 1000）。
接下来 t 行，每行一个字符串，长度在 1 到 100 之间，由 ASCII 码 33 到 126 的可见字符组成（不含空格）。
problem.output: t 行，每行输出 true 或 false：字符互不相同时输出 true。
problem.explanation: leetcode 里 e 出现了三次，所以是 false；abc 和 aA1! 的字符都不重复，都是 true。
hints: 用一个大小为 128 的布尔数组记录见过的字符，见到重复就停。
想不用额外的数据结构，可以先排序再比较相邻字符。用整数做位图时注意：可见字符有 94 种，32 位整数放不下，在很多语言里 1 << 40 会悄悄变成 1 << 8。

en.title: Are All Characters Different?
en.description:
For each given string, decide whether its characters are all different (upper and lower case letters are different characters).

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 01.01. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000).
Each of the next t lines holds a string of 1 to 100 visible ASCII characters, codes 33 to 126 (no spaces).
en.output: t lines, each true or false: true when no character repeats.
en.explanation: leetcode has three e's, so it is false; abc and aA1! repeat nothing, so both are true.
hints: Keep a boolean array of size 128 for the characters seen and stop at the first repeat.

Without extra structures, sort and compare neighbours. If you use an integer as a bitmap, note that there are 94 visible characters: a 32-bit integer cannot hold them, and in many languages 1 << 40 silently becomes 1 << 8.

problem.title: 按真实长度编码空格
problem.description:
一个字符数组的末尾预留了足够的空位，前 L 个字符才是真实内容。请把这 L 个字符里的每个空格替换成 %20，输出替换后的结果；末尾的预留空位不属于内容，不要输出。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 01.03。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 L（1 ≤ L ≤ 100000）。
第二行一个字符串，长度不小于 L，由字母、数字、标点和空格组成。前 L 个字符是真实内容（内容本身也可能以空格开头或结尾），其后都是空格。
problem.output: 一行，替换后的真实内容。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 的第二行是 "Mr John Smith" 后面跟 4 个预留空格，真实长度 13，结果是 Mr%20John%20Smith。
样例 2 的真实内容是 "a b "，末尾那个空格也是内容的一部分，要替换。
hints: 只处理前 L 个字符：先数出其中的空格数 c，结果长度就是 L + 2c；在原数组上从后往前填写，就不会覆盖还没处理的字符。
不要对整行去掉首尾空格，也不要把预留的空位也替换掉。

en.title: URL-encode Spaces Up to the True Length
en.description:
A character array has spare room at its end; only its first L characters are real content. Replace every space among those L characters with %20 and print the result; the spare room at the end is not content and is not printed.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 01.03. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer L (1 ≤ L ≤ 100000).
The second line holds a string of length at least L made of letters, digits, punctuation and spaces. Its first L characters are the content (which may itself start or end with spaces); everything after them is spaces.
en.output: One line: the content after the replacement.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the second line is "Mr John Smith" followed by 4 spare spaces; the true length is 13 and the result is Mr%20John%20Smith.
In sample 2 the content is "a b ", and its last space is content too, so it is replaced.
hints: Work on the first L characters only: count their spaces c; the result has length L + 2c. Filling the array from the back never overwrites characters you still need.
Do not trim the line, and do not encode the spare room.

problem.title: 只差一次编辑
problem.description:
对一个字符串可以做三种编辑：插入一个字符、删除一个字符、把一个字符换成另一个。给出若干对字符串，判断每对字符串能否通过最多一次编辑变得相同（两个字符串本来就相同也算）。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 01.05。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 1000）。
接下来 t 行，每行两个由小写字母组成的字符串 a 和 b，以空格分隔，长度都在 1 到 1000 之间。
problem.output: t 行，每行输出 true 或 false。
problem.explanation: pale 删掉 e 就是 pal，true；pales 和 pale 差一个 s，true；pale 把 p 换成 b 就是 bale，true；pale 和 bake 要换两个字符，false。
hints: 长度差超过 1 一定不行。长度相同时数对应位置不同字符的个数；长度差 1 时，用两个指针同时走，允许较长的那个跳过一个字符。
只统计每种字母的个数是不够的：顺序也要对上，例如 ab 和 ba 需要两次编辑。

en.title: One Edit Away
en.description:
A string can be edited in three ways: insert a character, delete a character, or replace one character with another. For each pair of strings, decide whether at most one edit makes them equal (pairs that are already equal count).

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 01.05. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000).
Each of the next t lines holds two lowercase strings a and b separated by a space, each of length 1 to 1000.
en.output: t lines, each true or false.
en.explanation: Deleting e from pale gives pal: true. pales and pale differ by one s: true. Replacing p in pale with b gives bale: true. pale and bake need two replacements: false.
hints: A length difference above 1 never works. With equal lengths, count the positions that differ; with lengths one apart, walk both strings with two pointers and let the longer one skip one character.
Counting letters is not enough, order matters too: ab and ba need two edits.

cases.input:

pales pale
pale bale
pale bake

problem.title: 连续字母计数压缩
problem.description:
把字符串里每一段连续相同的字母写成“字母 + 这段的长度”，例如 aabcccccaaa 写成 a2b1c5a3。如果这样写出来的结果没有比原字符串更短，就保留原字符串。请输出最终结果。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 01.06。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行字符串，长度在 1 到 50000 之间，只含大小写字母（大小写不同的字母算不同字母）。
problem.output: 一行，压缩后的字符串或原字符串。
problem.explanation:
aabcccccaaa 压缩成 a2b1c5a3，长 8，比原来的 11 短，所以输出压缩结果。
abbccd 压缩成 a1b2c2d1，长 8，没有更短，所以输出原字符串。
hints: 一次遍历，遇到字母变化时把上一段写出去，最后一段别忘了。长度可能是多位数，例如 a12。
拼接字符串时用 StringBuilder、列表等可变结构，避免每次拼接都复制整个字符串。

en.title: Run-Length Compression
en.description:
Write every run of equal letters in a string as the letter followed by the run's length: aabcccccaaa becomes a2b1c5a3. If the result is not shorter than the original string, keep the original. Print the final string.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 01.06. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line: a string of 1 to 50000 upper and lower case letters (different cases are different letters).
en.output: One line: the compressed string or the original.
en.explanation:
aabcccccaaa compresses to a2b1c5a3, length 8, shorter than the original 11, so the compressed form is printed.
abbccd compresses to a1b2c2d1, length 8, which is not shorter, so the original is printed.
hints: One pass: when the letter changes, write out the previous run, and do not forget the last one. A length can have several digits, as in a12.
Build the result with a StringBuilder, a list or another mutable buffer instead of copying the whole string on every append.

problem.title: 链表去重，保留第一次出现
problem.description:
给定一条未排序的单向链表，删除所有重复的值：每个值只保留它第一次出现的那个结点，其余结点的相对顺序不变。输出处理后的链表。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 02.01。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，从头到尾依次是每个结点的值，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 一行，去重后链表从头到尾的值，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中第二个 3 和第二个 1 都是重复的，删掉后是 1 2 3。
样例 2 中所有值相同，只剩第一个结点。
hints: 用哈希集合记录已经出现过的值，遍历时把重复的结点从链表上摘掉（让前一个结点跳过它）。
如果不允许额外空间，可以对每个结点再向后扫一遍删掉相同的值，时间是 O(n^2)。注意重复的值不一定挨在一起。

en.title: Remove Repeats From a List, Keeping the First
en.description:
Given an unsorted singly linked list, remove repeated values: keep only the first node holding each value and leave the other nodes in their order. Print the resulting list.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 02.01. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, the values from head to tail, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One line: the values from head to tail after removing repeats, separated by spaces.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the second 3 and the second 1 are repeats; removing them leaves 1 2 3.
In sample 2 every value is the same and only the first node remains.
hints: Track the values seen in a hash set and unlink each repeated node (point its predecessor past it).
Without extra space, scan ahead from every node and remove equal values, in O(n^2). Repeats need not be adjacent.

problem.title: 链表倒数第 k 个结点的值
problem.description:
给定一条单向链表和正整数 k，输出倒数第 k 个结点的值。尾结点是倒数第 1 个。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 02.02。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，从头到尾依次是每个结点的值，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 一个整数，倒数第 k 个结点的值。
problem.explanation: 链表 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 的倒数第 2 个结点是 4。
hints: 不知道链表长度时，可以让一个指针先走 k 步，再让两个指针同步前进，前面的指针走到末尾时，后面的指针就停在倒数第 k 个结点上。
先数出长度 n，再从头走 n-k 步，也只需要 O(1) 额外空间。

en.title: Value of the k-th Node From the End
en.description:
Given a singly linked list and a positive integer k, print the value of the k-th node from the end. The tail is the 1st from the end.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 02.02. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and k (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, the values from head to tail, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One integer: the value of the k-th node from the end.
en.explanation: In the list 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 the 2nd node from the end holds 4.
hints: Without knowing the length, let one pointer go k steps first, then advance both together; when the leading pointer runs off the end, the trailing one sits on the k-th node from the end.
Counting the length n first and then walking n-k steps from the head also uses O(1) extra space.

problem.title: 按基准值把链表分成两段
problem.description:
给定一条单向链表和基准值 x，重新排列链表：所有值小于 x 的结点排在前面，值大于或等于 x 的结点排在后面。两部分内部都要保持结点原来的先后顺序。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 02.04。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 x（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，绝对值不超过 10^9）。
第二行 n 个整数，从头到尾依次是每个结点的值，绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 一行 n 个整数，重排后链表从头到尾的值，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: x = 3 时，小于 3 的结点依次是 1、2、2，其余依次是 4、3、5，所以结果是 1 2 2 4 3 5。注意等于 3 的结点属于后半段。
hints: 建两条新链表（各带一个哨兵头结点），遍历原链表时把结点分别接到它们的尾部，最后把两条首尾相连。
每次把小结点插到表头虽然也能分开两部分，但会把它们的顺序颠倒。

en.title: Split a List Around a Pivot
en.description:
Given a singly linked list and a pivot x, rearrange the list so that every node with a value less than x comes first and every node with a value greater than or equal to x comes after them. Both parts keep their nodes' original order.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 02.04. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and x (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, |x| ≤ 10^9).
The second line holds n integers, the values from head to tail, each with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One line with the n values of the rearranged list from head to tail, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: With x = 3 the nodes below 3 are 1, 2, 2 in order and the rest 4, 3, 5, so the result is 1 2 2 4 3 5. A node equal to 3 belongs to the second part.
hints: Build two new lists (each with a sentinel head), append every node to the tail of one of them while walking the original, then join them.
Inserting each small node at the head also separates the parts, but reverses their order.

problem.title: 一个数组装三个栈
problem.description:
用一个长度为 3c 的数组同时实现 0、1、2 号三个栈，每个栈最多容纳 c 个元素。支持以下操作：
push s v：把 v 压入 s 号栈；如果这个栈已满，忽略这次操作；
pop s：弹出并输出 s 号栈的栈顶，栈空时输出 -1；
peek s：输出 s 号栈的栈顶但不弹出，栈空时输出 -1；
empty s：s 号栈为空时输出 true，否则输出 false。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 03.01。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 c 和 q（1 ≤ c ≤ 1000，1 ≤ q ≤ 100000）。
接下来 q 行，每行一个操作，0 ≤ s ≤ 2，0 ≤ v ≤ 10^9。
problem.output: 对每个 pop、peek、empty 操作输出一行结果。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 中每个栈只能放 1 个元素，第二次 push 0 2 被忽略，所以 pop 0 弹出 1；之后 0 号栈空了，再弹出得到 -1；1 号栈从未放过元素，empty 1 为 true。
hints: 把数组分成三段，第 s 段是 [s·c, (s+1)·c)，再用三个变量记录每个栈当前的元素个数。
每个栈的容量是独立的：一个栈满了，不能借用别的栈的空位。

en.title: Three Stacks in One Array
en.input:
The first line holds two integers c and q (1 ≤ c ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ q ≤ 100000).
Each of the next q lines is one operation, with 0 ≤ s ≤ 2 and 0 ≤ v ≤ 10^9.
en.output: One line for each pop, peek and empty.
en.explanation: In sample 1 every stack holds 1 element, so the second push 0 2 is ignored and pop 0 returns 1; stack 0 is then empty and the next pop gives -1. Stack 1 never received anything, so empty 1 is true.
hints: Split the array into three slices, slice s being [s·c, (s+1)·c), and keep a size for each stack.
The capacities are separate: a full stack cannot borrow the free slots of another.

push 0 1
push 0 2
pop 0
pop 0
empty 1

problem.title: 一摞摞的盘子
problem.description:
盘子叠得太高会倒，所以每摞最多放 cap 个盘子，放满了就另起一摞。把所有摞从左到右编号为 0、1、2……，实现下面的操作：
push v：在最右边那一摞上放一个编号为 v 的盘子；如果没有任何一摞或最右边那摞已满，就在最右边新起一摞；
pop：从最右边那一摞取下最上面的盘子并输出它的编号，没有盘子时输出 -1；
popAt i：从第 i 摞取下最上面的盘子并输出编号，第 i 摞不存在时输出 -1。
任何一摞被取空后都立即撤掉，它右边的各摞编号依次减 1。注意 cap 可能是 0，这时什么都放不上去。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 03.03。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 cap 和 q（0 ≤ cap ≤ 1000，1 ≤ q ≤ 100000）。
接下来 q 行，每行一个操作，0 ≤ v ≤ 10^9，0 ≤ i ≤ 10^5。
problem.output: 对每个 pop 和 popAt 操作输出一行结果。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 中 cap = 2：放入 1、2、3 后，第 0 摞是 [1, 2]，第 1 摞是 [3]。popAt 1 取出 3，第 1 摞空了被撤掉；接着 pop 取出 2，再 pop 取出 1；之后没有盘子了，输出 -1。
hints: 用一个“栈的列表”，push 和 pop 只看最后一个栈，popAt 直接访问下标 i。
别忘了把取空的摞删掉，否则后面的编号和 pop 的结果都会错；cap 为 0 时 push 什么都不做。

en.title: Stacks of Plates
en.input:
The first line holds two integers cap and q (0 ≤ cap ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ q ≤ 100000).
Each of the next q lines is one operation, with 0 ≤ v ≤ 10^9 and 0 ≤ i ≤ 10^5.
en.output: One line for each pop and popAt.
en.explanation: In sample 1, cap = 2: after pushing 1, 2 and 3, pile 0 is [1, 2] and pile 1 is [3]. popAt 1 takes 3 and pile 1, now empty, is removed; pop then takes 2 and the next pop takes 1; with no plates left the last pop prints -1.
hints: Keep a list of stacks: push and pop look at the last one, popAt indexes pile i directly.
Remove emptied piles, or the numbering and later pops go wrong; with cap 0, push does nothing.

设计一个特殊的栈，无论以什么顺序放入元素，栈顶总是当前最小的元素。支持以下操作：
push v：放入 v；
pop：移除栈顶（也就是最小的那个元素）；栈空时什么也不做，也不输出；
peek：输出栈顶元素，栈空时输出 -1；
isEmpty：栈空时输出 true，否则输出 false。
原题要求只借助一个额外的栈来完成排序，这里不做强制。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 03.05。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 q（1 ≤ q ≤ 100000）。
接下来 q 行，每行一个操作，1 ≤ v ≤ 10^9。
problem.output: 对每个 peek 和 isEmpty 操作输出一行结果。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 依次放入 3、1、2，栈顶是最小的 1；pop 移除 1 后栈顶变为 2。
hints: 书中的做法：放入 v 时，把主栈顶上比 v 小的元素暂时挪到辅助栈，放下 v 后再挪回去，主栈始终从顶到底递增。
用堆（优先队列）也能达到每次 O(log n)。

en.title: A Stack With the Minimum on Top
en.input:
The first line holds an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 100000).
Each of the next q lines is one operation, with 1 ≤ v ≤ 10^9.
en.output: One line for each peek and isEmpty.
en.explanation: Sample 1 pushes 3, 1 and 2; the top is the smallest, 1. After pop removes 1, the top is 2.
hints: The book's way: to push v, move the main stack's top elements smaller than v onto a helper stack, put v down, then move them back, so the main stack always increases from top to bottom.
A heap (priority queue) gets O(log n) per operation too.

problem.title: 动物收容所
problem.description:
收容所只收猫和狗，严格按“先来先领养”的规则：领养人可以要“最早来的那只动物”（不论猫狗），也可以指定要猫或要狗，这时得到的是最早来的那只猫或那只狗。每只动物有一个编号，编号互不相同，但和到达的先后没有关系。实现以下操作：
enqueue id k：编号为 id 的动物来到收容所，k = 0 表示猫，k = 1 表示狗；
dequeueAny：领走最早来的动物；
dequeueDog：领走最早来的狗；
dequeueCat：领走最早来的猫。
每次领养输出被领走动物的“id k”，没有符合要求的动物时输出 -1 -1。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 03.06。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 q（1 ≤ q ≤ 100000）。
接下来 q 行，每行一个操作，0 ≤ id ≤ 10^9，k 为 0 或 1。
problem.output: 对每个领养操作输出一行，两个整数。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 中先来的是猫 30，然后是狗 10、狗 20。dequeueAny 领走最早的猫 30；dequeueCat 时已经没有猫，输出 -1 -1；dequeueDog 领走狗 10。
hints: 猫和狗各用一个队列，同时给每只动物记下到达的序号。dequeueAny 比较两个队首谁的序号更小。
不要用动物的编号判断先后，编号和到达顺序无关。

en.title: Animal Shelter
en.input:
The first line holds an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 100000).
Each of the next q lines is one operation, with 0 ≤ id ≤ 10^9 and k equal to 0 or 1.
en.output: One line with two integers for each adoption.
en.explanation: In sample 1, cat 30 arrives first, then dogs 10 and 20. dequeueAny adopts cat 30; at dequeueCat no cat is left, so -1 -1; dequeueDog adopts dog 10.
hints: Keep a queue for cats and one for dogs, and stamp each animal with its arrival number; dequeueAny compares the two fronts' stamps.
Do not order animals by id: ids say nothing about arrival.

problem.title: 两个结点之间有没有路
problem.description:
给定一张有向图，结点编号为 0 到 n-1，边可能有重复，也可能有自环。判断能否从结点 s 出发、沿着边的方向走到结点 t。s 和 t 相同时视为可以到达。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 04.01。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，0 ≤ m ≤ 100000）。
接下来 m 行，每行两个整数 u 和 v，表示一条从 u 指向 v 的边。
最后一行两个整数 s 和 t。
problem.output: 能到达输出 true，否则输出 false。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中有边 0→1、0→2、1→2、1→2（重复）、2→0，从 0 出发可以经过 0→2 到达 2，所以输出 true。
样例 2 中只有边 1→0，方向相反，从 0 走不到 1。
hints: 从 s 做 BFS 或 DFS，用 visited 数组避免重复访问，遇到 t 就可以提前结束。
边是有方向的，建图时只加 u→v 这一个方向。

en.title: Is There a Route Between Two Nodes?
en.description:
Given a directed graph with nodes 0 to n-1, possibly with repeated edges and self-loops, decide whether node t can be reached from node s by following edges in their direction. A node reaches itself.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 04.01. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 100000).
Each of the next m lines holds two integers u and v: an edge from u to v.
The last line holds two integers s and t.
en.output: Print true if t is reachable from s, otherwise false.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 has the edges 0→1, 0→2, 1→2, 1→2 (repeated) and 2→0; from 0 the edge 0→2 reaches 2, so the answer is true.
Sample 2 has only the edge 1→0, which points the other way, so 1 cannot be reached from 0.
hints: Run BFS or DFS from s with a visited array and stop as soon as t shows up.
Edges have a direction: add only u→v when building the graph.

problem.title: 二叉树每一层的结点
problem.description:
一棵二叉树有 n 个结点，编号为 1 到 n。请把每一层的结点值按从左到右的顺序列出来，从根所在的第一层开始。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 04.03。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 root（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，1 ≤ root ≤ n）。
接下来 n 行，第 i 行三个整数 v、l、r：i 号结点的值为 v（绝对值不超过 10^9），左孩子编号为 l，右孩子编号为 r，没有孩子时写 0。
problem.output:
第一行一个整数 d，表示树的层数。
接下来 d 行，第 i 行先输出第 i 层的结点个数 k，再从左到右输出这一层的 k 个结点值，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 的根是 1 号结点（值 1），第二层是 2、3，第三层是 4、5、7，第四层是 8。
hints: 按层 BFS：每一轮先记下队列当前的长度，这么多个结点就是同一层，处理完再进入下一层。
也可以 DFS 时带上深度，把结点追加到对应深度的列表里；只要先访问左孩子，同层顺序就是从左到右。

en.title: The Nodes on Each Level of a Tree
en.description:
A binary tree has n nodes numbered 1 to n. List the values on every level from left to right, starting with the root's level.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 04.03. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and root (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 1 ≤ root ≤ n).
Line i of the next n lines holds three integers v, l and r: node i has value v (absolute value at most 10^9), left child l and right child r, with 0 for no child.
en.output:
The first line holds d, the number of levels.
Each of the next d lines starts with k, the number of nodes on that level, followed by the k values from left to right, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: In sample 1 the root is node 1 (value 1); the second level holds 2 and 3, the third 4, 5 and 7, and the fourth 8.
hints: Breadth-first by levels: at each round note the queue's current length; that many nodes form one level.
Or carry the depth through a DFS and append each node to its depth's list; visiting the left child first keeps each level in left-to-right order.

problem.title: 能建出同一棵搜索树的插入顺序
problem.description:
把一组互不相同的数依次插入一棵空的二叉搜索树（比当前结点小往左走、大往右走，走到空位就放下），不同的插入顺序可能得到同一棵树。给定一棵二叉搜索树，请列出所有能建出它的插入顺序。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 04.09。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行，按层序给出这棵树：结点值以空格分隔，空结点写作 null，末尾的 null 省略。树有 1 到 12 个结点，结点值是 1 到 100 之间互不相同的整数。保证答案不超过 5000 个。
problem.output: 每行一个插入顺序，n 个数以空格分隔。所有顺序按字典序从小到大排列（逐个比较数值的大小，先出现较小数值的排前面）。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 的树根是 2，左孩子 1、右孩子 3。根必须最先插入，1 和 3 的先后无所谓，所以有 2 1 3 和 2 3 1 两种。
hints: 根总在最前面。左子树的任意一个合法顺序和右子树的任意一个合法顺序，可以像洗牌一样交错合并，只要各自内部的先后不变。
递归求出两棵子树的所有顺序，再枚举所有交错方式。最后按数值排序，不要把它们当成字符串排序（"10" 会排在 "9" 前面）。

en.title: Insertion Orders That Build the Same Search Tree
en.description:
Inserting distinct numbers one by one into an empty binary search tree (go left when smaller, right when larger, and place the value at the empty spot) can give the same tree for different orders. Given a binary search tree, list every insertion order that builds it.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 04.09. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line giving the tree in level order: values separated by spaces, null for a missing child, trailing nulls left out. The tree has 1 to 12 nodes with distinct integer values from 1 to 100. There are at most 5000 orders.
en.output: One order per line, its n numbers separated by spaces. List the orders in increasing lexicographic order, comparing numbers by value (the order with the smaller number at the first difference comes first).
en.explanation: In sample 1 the root is 2 with left child 1 and right child 3. The root has to come first and 1 and 3 can come in either order, so the orders are 2 1 3 and 2 3 1.
hints: The root always comes first. Any valid order of the left subtree and any valid order of the right subtree can be shuffled together like two decks of cards, as long as each keeps its own order.
Recurse for both subtrees, then enumerate every interleaving. Sort by value at the end, not as strings ("10" would come before "9").
